  }

  }

    id?: string;

    forecastTimeRange?: string; // 时间段

    projectCode?: string; // 项目编码
    [key: string]: any;
  }
  export interface CalcInstanceParams {
    metricCode: string;
    reportYear: number | string | undefined;
    reportMonth?: number | string | undefined;
    value: any;
  }
  export interface FormulaListParams {
    'mm.versionCode': string;
  }
}

// 删除实例
export async function deleteInstance(params: InstanceApi.DeleteInstanceParams) {
  return requestClient.delete(`/economodel/datamodelversion/removeAll`, {
    data: params,
  });
}

// 保存版本实例数据
export async function saveInstanceData(
  params: InstanceApi.SaveInstanceParams[],
) {
  return requestClient.put(`${BASE_URL}/economodel/dataentry/saveAll`, params);
}

// 保存版本
export async function saveInstanceConfig(
  params: InstanceApi.SaveInstanceConfigParams,
) {
  return requestClient.put(
    `${BASE_URL}/economodel/datamodelversion/save`,
    params,
  );
}

// 保存版本配置项
export async function updateInstanceConfig(
  params: InstanceApi.SaveInstanceConfigParams,
) {
  return requestClient.put(
    `${BASE_URL}/economodel/datamodelversion/saveOrUpdate`,
    params,
  );
}

// 计算接口
export async function calcInstance(params: InstanceApi.CalcInstanceParams) {
  return requestClient.post(
    `${BASE_URL}/economodel/modelformula/fetchMetricsImpactedByValue`,
    params,
  );
}

export async function getMetricInfo(params: any) {
  return requestClient.post(`${BASE_URL}/economodel/datametric/list`, params);
}
